pr_title: sql: Fix mutex leak within TestCheckConstraintDropAndColumn
pr_body:
The test does not unlock the jobControlMu mutex in the case of an error. This PR fixes that.

Epic: none
Fixes: https://github.com/cockroachdb/cockroach/issues/107433
Release note: none
pr_comments: This change is [](https://reviewable.io/reviews/cockroachdb/cockroach/107915)
This PR was included in a batch that timed out, it will be automatically retried

issue_context.title: potential mutex leaks
issue_context.body:
While writing a custom linter for [1], I added a naive check for potential mutex leaks. Despite a high number of false positives, the full set was small enough to perform a manual audit,

```
wc -l ~/leaked_mutex.txt
      40 /Users/srosenberg/leaked_mutex.txt
```

After inspecting the code, the following appear to be true positives,

```
/Users/srosenberg/workspace/go/src/github.com/cockroachdb/cockroach/pkg/sql/conn_executor.go:2927:4
lock "ex.mu" may have leaked at /Users/srosenberg/workspace/go/src/github.com/cockroachdb/cockroach/pkg/sql/conn_executor.go:3189:4
lock "jobControlMu" may have leaked at /Users/srosenberg/workspace/go/src/github.com/cockroachdb/cockroach/pkg/sql/schema_changer_test.go:7011:6
lock "jobControlMu" may have leaked at /Users/srosenberg/workspace/go/src/github.com/cockroachdb/cockroach/pkg/sql/schema_changer_test.go:7298:6
lock "ex.mu" may have leaked at 
```

In `conn_executor`, `ex.mu.Lock()` is not released upon error [2]. According to FSM, `eventNonRetriableErr` doesn't change state, which suggests a deadlock is possible?

In `TestDropColumnAfterMutations` (and in `TestCheckConstraintDropAndColumn`), `jobControlMu` is not released upon error [3]. If resume is retried, a deadlock will occur. Note, the test is currently skipped due to being "flaky" [4]. It's not immediately clear if the observed leaked goroutine is related.


[1] https://github.com/cockroachdb/cockroach/issues/105366#issuecomment-1647159766
[2] https://github.com/cockroachdb/cockroach/blob/d293bb3acd9b7f67ac793ddb6a0836e637864629/pkg/sql/conn_executor.go#L2924-L2928
[3] https://github.com/cockroachdb/cockroach/blob/d293bb3acd9b7f67ac793ddb6a0836e637864629/pkg/sql/schema_changer_test.go#L7008-L7011
[4] https://github.com/cockroachdb/cockroach/issues/76843

Jira issue: CRDB-30040

review_comments: nit: consider adding a quick note about the usage of the mutex below? At first glance, I was confused about why this wasn't a `defer jobControlMu.Unlock()`.
